sloka: अनेन दत्तानि सुपूजितानि भुक्ताश्च भोगा निभृताश्च भृत्याः ।धनानि मित्रेषु समर्पितानि वैराण्यमित्रेषु च यापितानि ।। ६.११२.२३ ।।
transliteration: anena dattāni supūjitāni bhuktāśca bhogā nibhṛtāśca bhṛtyāḥ ।dhanāni mitreṣu samarpitāni vairāṇyamitreṣu ca yāpitāni ।। 6.112.23 ।।

translations.english: "He bestowed gifts to mendicants, nurtured dependents, filled his friends with wealth, and held grudges against enemies and destroyed them."
